title: agent.lock
description: A generated record of exactly what an agent deployment was made of. Pins values, never ranges. Contains no prompt text and no tool output, so it is safe to share.

hosted.description: True for vendor-hosted agents whose version the operator cannot observe or pin.

snapshot.description: Dated snapshot id, never a floating alias.

weightsDigest.description: sha256 of weights, for self-hosted models.

promptSha256.description: Recorded for forensics. Never a matching key; see SCHEMA.md.

exposure.description: Who can reach the agent's own listening interfaces, if it has any.

harnessSettings.description: Normalized, harness-independent vocabulary. An emitter maps the harness's native settings onto these keys. Unknown keys are allowed but no advisory may depend on them.

toolApproval.description: Whether a human confirms tool calls. 'ask-once' = approval is remembered per tool. 'auto' = no confirmation.

configWriteApproval.description: Whether the agent can modify its own configuration (MCP server list, approval settings) without a human confirming.

toolDefinitionPinning.description: True if a change to an approved tool's definition or description forces re-approval.

projectConfigTrust.description: How configuration supplied by an opened project or repository is treated.

remoteContentRendering.description: True if agent output can cause the client to fetch attacker-chosen URLs (e.g. markdown images).

pinned.description: True if the tool is pinned to an exact version or content hash.

integrity.description: Hash of the tool's definitions as approved.

capabilities.description: A complete statement: listed capabilities are present, unlisted ones absent. Omit it when not known, and audit resolves each capability from the capability catalogue by `source` and `version`; see SCHEMA.md.

grants.description: What this tool was actually allowed to touch. Free-form, but see SCHEMA.md for conventional keys.
